text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends the installation of a no standing zone on the south side of Scottfield Drive in the area of the two driveways at 33 Scottfield Drive. Currently, at 33 Scottfield Drive, parking is permitted for a maximum period of three hours on both sides of Scottfield Drive.
The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Prohibited standing at all times on the south side of Scottfield Drive, between a point 138 metres east of Middlefield Road and a point 78 metres further east.
